dct_description_sm: Analyses include pH, electric conductivity, concentrations of all major anions (nitrite, bromide, sulphate, nitrate), concentrations of all major cations (lithium, sodium, ammonium, potassium, magnesium, calcium, strontium), and delta-18O/delta-D values. Data is used to determine suitability of different physical, chemical and physicochemical tracers in the watershed for source separation research.
dct_title_s: 2012 and 2013 Upper Goose stream water ion concentration and stable isotope ratio data
